description: This file defines the schema, methods, events, and data structures for a Bluetooth API in JSON format, serving as a comprehensive interface definition for Bluetooth device management and interaction.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Initiates the connection with the given Bluetooth device. Triggers `onStatusChanged` event.

methods.name: disable
methods.description: Disables the Bluetooth stack.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects the given device from this device ID and triggers `onStatusChanged` Event.

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Enables the Bluetooth stack.

methods.name: getAudioInfo
methods.description: Provides information on the currently playing song/audio from an external source.

methods.name: getConnectedDevices
methods.description: Returns a list of devices connected to this device.

methods.name: getDeviceInfo
methods.description: Returns information for the given device ID.

methods.name: getDiscoveredDevices
methods.description: Returns an array of devices discovered during scanning.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of this device as seen by other Bluetooth devices.

methods.name: getPairedDevices
methods.description: Returns a list of devices that have paired with this device.

methods.name: isDiscoverable
methods.description: Returns `true`, if this device can be discovered by other Bluetooth devices.

methods.name: pair
methods.description: Pairs this device with device ID of Bluetooth. Triggers `onStatusChanged` and `onRequestFailed` events.

methods.name: respondToEvent
methods.description: Provides the ability to respond to Bluetooth events like pairing or connection requests.

methods.name: sendAudioPlaybackCommand
methods.description: Provides control over the connected source with commands like PLAY, PAUSE, STOP, etc.

methods.name: setAudioStream
methods.description: Sets the primary or secondary audio-out to the given Bluetooth device.

methods.name: setDiscoverable
methods.description: Sets the device discoverability status with optional timeout.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of this device as seen by other Bluetooth devices.

methods.name: startScan
methods.description: Starts scanning for other Bluetooth devices that match the given profile. Sends `onStatusChanged` and `onDiscoveredDevice` events.

methods.name: stopScan
methods.description: Stops scanning for Bluetooth devices if in progress.

methods.name: unpair
methods.description: Unpairs the given device ID from this device. Triggers `onStatusChanged` event.

methods.name: getDeviceVolumeMuteInfo
methods.description: Gets the volume and mute status of the given Bluetooth device ID.

methods.name: setDeviceVolumeMuteInfo
methods.description: Sets the volume of the connected Bluetooth device ID and triggers `onDeviceMediaStatus` event.

methods.name: getApiVersionNumber
methods.description: Provides the current API version number.
